description: An upstream stream that ends cleanly after a text delta, with no message_delta and no message_stop, is reported to the client as an incomplete stream rather than a finished message.

exceptions.reason: Both cores end the stream with an error event; the error's message wording differs.

Today's core reaches a Messages upstream only through its Claude API-key provider, which rewrites the request even for a custom base URL: it adds cache_control breakpoints, removes the thinking setting and thinking blocks whose signatures it cannot verify, drops a cache TTL, adds stream false, adds ?beta=true and sends the key as a bearer token with its own Accept and Accept-Encoding. The new core passes a Messages request to a Messages upstream unchanged, thinking blocks, signatures and cache_control included, and sends the key in x-api-key as Anthropic's API defines; Claude-specific rewrites belong to the Claude provider extension (slice 10).
